Novelty Drinkware — Disco Ball Cups and Beer Bats

Statement pieces that sell the photograph: mirror-finish disco ball cups and 21.6 oz beer bats with optional stand.

Request novelty drinkware pricing Custom logo options

About this range

Some products exist to be photographed and posted, and that is exactly what this line does. The electroplated disco ball cup ships with a straw and turns any cocktail into a mirror-ball moment; the 21.6 oz beer bat is a proven revenue driver at sports bars, festivals and themed venues where guests buy the vessel, not just the drink. Both are available with colour-box packaging and logo printing for retail and gifting programmes.

Novelty Drinkware — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Novelty Drinkware range include?

This range holds 3 items, specified in PS (with electroplating), PP and ABS. Orders come most often from themed bars and nightclubs, sports bars and festivals. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

What novelty drinkware can I source in bulk?

This range covers the shapes, capacities and materials listed on the product cards, with gift-set configurations available. Each product page states its exact available specification and customization route.

Beer glasses and mugs

Can novelty drinkware be branded for a distillery, brewery or bar?

Branding feasibility is confirmed from the selected item, artwork, decoration area, quantity and required packaging. Provide the logo and the intended application for a product-specific recommendation.

Bars and nightclubs · Logo decoration guide

How is a gift set configured?

The set is specified as a complete build: the items, any accessories, the insert, the gift box, branding, the outer carton and the quantity. We do not use generic set specifications when the actual configured contents differ.

Barware gift sets

What is the difference between a standard order and a branded gift-set order?

A standard order is quoted against the selected product specification. A branded gift set requires additional confirmation for decoration, packing materials, insert configuration and the complete order quantity.
